reuse.why: Adds the template exclusion to the existing getBudgetActionCategories policy helper that all month-wide actions already use, but derives the template flag by extending each action's own SQL rather than a shared query.

duplication.why: The same 'CASE WHEN c.goal_def IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_template' fragment is pasted into five queries (getBudgetData plus four identical per-action category SELECTs), deepening the existing copy-pasted query instead of extracting it.

placement.why: The skip decision lives in the shared eligibility helper in budget/actions.ts, but what counts as 'has a template' is decided in SQL at each query site.

scope.why: Touches only the month-wide action eligibility (including flipping setZero's hidden policy to match the request) and adds a test.

maintainability.why: Changing the definition of a saved template now needs five identical SQL edits, and the includeHidden* policy object is left with every caller passing false.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) filter through getBudgetActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The has_template SQL fragment is duplicated verbatim across queries, not disguised.

one_place.where: The exclusion check is in getBudgetActionCategories, but the template predicate itself (goal_def IS NOT NULL -> has_template) is defined separately in getBudgetData and in the SELECTs of setZero, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and set6MonthAvg.
